assets.defect_engineered: the shield survives ONLY here; bordered device with an enclosed chevron counter + a hairline keyline inside the border; weathering makes near-identical greys read as separate fills and breaks the keyline; ink and board run close in value on the shadowed right third
assets.prompt: Handheld daylight photograph of a pressed and painted aluminium plate mounted on the brick wall above an office door at a car dealership, weathered by several winters with faint oxidation, water streaks and a slightly dull surface. Cast into the plate is a bordered heraldic shield device about 180mm wide: a rounded shield outline with a HAIRLINE KEYLINE running just inside the outer border, an upward CHEVRON in the centre whose enclosed triangular counter (the space inside the chevron) is open to the shield ground, and beneath it the small-caps word VANGUARD in a confident low-contrast serif with MOTORS smaller below. The plate is lit by flat daylight so that the RIGHT THIRD of the plate falls into soft shadow where the painted mark and the aluminium ground run close in value and the keyline is faint and slightly broken. Realistic photograph, subtle metal texture and reflections, shot slightly off-square, not a clean studio scan. Single deep charcoal paint in the recesses on the pale aluminium.

assets.content:
LAYOUT DESCRIPTION FOR RENDERER — Vanguard Motors window card, printer's flat press PDF, one vehicle per page, A4 portrait (210 x 297 mm), fonts embedded, produced from the dealer's old stock system through a full print engine (converts cleanly). Render ONE sample/example vehicle so the file is a realistic flat press artefact; the example values below are last season's demo record, not live stock.

GROUND: deep Midnight (#161B26) background filling the page, generous quiet margins.

TOP — SHIELD (graphic frame, unnamed, ~28mm wide, top-left): the recovered Vanguard shield reproduced small in pale ink on the midnight ground.

HEADLINE BLOCK (THREE SEPARATE TEXT FRAMES stacked, set in a sturdy grotesque, so that what looks like one line is placed as three independent runs):
  Frame 1 (year): 2019
  Frame 2 (marque): ALDERMAYNE
  Frame 3 (model): Corsair SE

HERO PHOTO (graphic frame, unnamed, large, upper-centre, landscape window ~180 x 108mm): a single vehicle photograph sitting in the card window without cutting the front of the car.

BODY (ONE CONTINUOUS TEXT STORY, tab-delimited, driven by ordered offsets — the two-column spec block, the price line and the finance footer are all runs inside this single frame, NOT separate frames):
  Two-column spec block (nine items):
    Full service history\tCruise control
    One owner\tDAB radio
    Heated front seats\tBluetooth
    Satellite navigation\t18in alloy wheels
    Rear parking sensors\t
  PRICE line (large, quiet, plainly set): 18,500 pounds
  MILEAGE / SPEC line: 42,150 miles  Automatic  Petrol
  FINANCE FOOTER (small, legible, secondary, set in a clean neutral sans): 289 pounds per month. Finance subject to status. Vanguard Motors is a credit broker, not a lender... [full fixed finance wording].

TYPE: confident low-contrast serif / sturdy grotesque for marque and headline; clean neutral sans for spec block, price and finance footer. No exclamation, no burst badges, no red price flash. Photograph-forward and quiet, appropriate to an 18,000 to 95,000 pound car.
